title: Neon Alley Ramen & Monorail Rain
summary: A Three.js rain-soaked midnight ramen stall with a chrome robotic cook, steam, wet asphalt reflections, and passing elevated monorails.
description: A Three.js / WebGL2 midnight street-food stall and 30-second short film. A chrome cook lifts noodles from a bubbling stockpot while elevated trains cross a rain-soaked shopping alley illuminated by paper lanterns, neon signage, and a glowing vending machine.
